body.name: service
body.description: One service line the clinic sells to organisations, for example a type of assessment, programme or screening. A catalogue entry with price and delivery mode. Holds no patient or health data.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: The service line as sold, for example a type of workplace assessment.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.service}.

body.name: service_contract
body.description: The agreement under which the clinic provides services to one employer or insurer, with its term, pricing basis and renewal date. Created when a deal is won. Holds only commercial terms and aggregate headcount, never information about any patient.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Organisation name and the word contract. Never include a person's name.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.service_contract}.

body.name: referral_agreement
body.description: The working arrangement with one referral partner, such as a broker, insurer panel or another provider. Tracks governance checks and the agreement. Volumes are aggregate counts only. Never record who was referred or why.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Partner organisation name and the word agreement.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.referral_agreement}.
